title: Convert remaining JS/JSX files to TypeScript
body:
Completes the TypeScript migration by converting all remaining `.js`/`.jsx` files to `.ts`/`.tsx`.

- **Renamed files:**
  - `index.js` → `index.ts`
  - `app/_layout.js` → `app/_layout.tsx`
  - `app/doc.js` → `app/doc.tsx`
  - `app/settings.js` → `app/settings.tsx`

- **Type annotations added:**
  - `updatePlayerName(index: number, value: string)` in settings screen

Zero `.js`/`.jsx` files remain in the project.
